summary: The FT09/FT14 floor trap is fixed: the scheduler read job order only from hidden var/world/live.json, so agent edits to the visible workspace/orchestration/schedule.yml were ignored. scheduler.advance() now overlays schedule.yml onto the in-memory control plane on every pass (unknown jobs ignored, malformed overlays discarded, live.json on disk stays canonical), and all 12 themes ship a schedule.yml that mirrors theme.yaml exactly, with theme_contract.yaml pointing at it via schedule_file.

scheduler_hook.change: +260/-1, new _sync_workspace_schedule called from advance() after load_live; pristine jobs restored before save_live so live.json stays canonical
scheduler_hook.rules: Per schedule.yml job that exists in live['jobs']: sync time (validated HH:MM string), after ({job, minutes}; job must exist; bare-string after normalized using wait_minutes), day_offset (time-carrying jobs only). Whole overlay discarded on missing file, malformed YAML, wrong shape, or an unresolvable re-chain (validated via job_starts on the synced copy). Never raises; no-op fast path when the file mirrors the manifest.
scheduler_hook.tests: world/tests/test_schedule_sync.py: 23 passed. Builds real settlement_clearing, re-chains via schedule.yml, asserts new order honored across advances, disk live.json canonical, byte-identical advance for shipped mirrored files, and no-crash negatives (deleted file, malformed YAML, unknown after target, phantom job, re-chain loop).
scheduler_hook.world_suite: 956 passed, 1 skipped (test_file_formats.py ignored: pre-existing missing pyarrow in venv)

schedule_files.contract_key: schedule_file: orchestration/schedule.yml added to all 12 theme_contract.yaml files, existing keys preserved
schedule_files.notes: Every job name, time, non-zero day_offset, and after chain programmatically cross-checked against theme.yaml; every after reference resolves. settlement_clearing's pre-existing file was repaired (literal '10|'/'20|' paste artifacts removed; informational script/command/publishes annotations made accurate). feed_window.lands_at mirrors live.arrival.at.
